description: Apache Airflow CLI: connections, variables, and configuration with secrets, metadata database resets, DAG deletion, users, and read commands. DAG runs and task tests run the code of the project.

rules.note: Connections hold passwords and keys. `connections list`, `get`, and `export`, `variables list`, `get`, and `export`, and `config list` and `get-value` print or write them. `info` prints the configuration too.
`db reset`, `db clean`, and `db downgrade` delete or revert the metadata database. `dags delete` removes the run history of a DAG. `tasks clear` resets task instances so they run again.
User and role changes decide who can run DAGs and read connections.

project_commands.note: `dags test`, `dags trigger`, `dags backfill`, `tasks test`, and `tasks run` run the task code of the project, which can call any system.

safe.note: Listings of DAGs, import errors, runs, and tasks, DAG and task states, the version, and checks of the database and jobs.
